answer: Farming becomes a prism bet on surviving 53 epochs of grading, and every juniper settlement recomputes the canyon schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 53 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
